sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 85 x 25 x 104 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Wisycom MCR54 datasheet rev b10 (dealer-hosted copy of the manufacturer document), opened 2026-11-12: 104 x 85 x 25 mm (H x W x D) as printed, 230 g, slot-style four-channel true-diversity receiver (not a 19 in unit: the plan family label rack-box-v2 is replaced by a moulded box), two SMA antenna inputs (no catalogue signal), audio output on a 5-pin mini-XLR (the Bêta proposal files it under mini-xlr-ta4, the closest id, which is the 4-pin TA4: kept as is), 3.5 mm headphone jack, USB-C control, DC powered (no mains inlet). The datasheet gives no panel per connector. Beta-modelled with the proposal ports kept exactly; no controls. Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened. Connector genders not stated by the source follow the convention input = female, output = male.
